question: I'm a CS 5th-year student (P-046) on academic warning with a Math minor. Given my AW restrictions and remaining requirements, can I realistically complete both the CS degree and Math minor by Spring 2026?

domain_contributions.programs: P-046 has completed core CS milestones and extensive Math minor courses (21-355, 21-356, 21-484, etc.); remaining requirements likely include CS electives (15-316, 15-440) and any Math minor gaps
domain_contributions.policies: AW = normal load cap (~45 units); Spring 2026 is one semester — capacity is ~3-4 courses

key_facts: 15-440 (possibly required) NOT offered Spring 2026 — critical bottleneck
AW: normal load = ~3-4 courses; cannot overload
If 15-440 is a remaining requirement, graduation by Spring 2026 is NOT feasible
wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing only program requirements identifies 15-440 as needed. Knowing only the schedule reveals 15-440 is not offered Spring 2026. Only combining these domains reveals the bottleneck. The AW policy adds a third constraint limiting how much can be completed even if courses were available.
common_mistake: Assuming remaining CS courses can be completed in one semester without checking Spring 2026 availability; missing that 15-440 is only offered in Fall semesters
reasoning_chain: Step 1 (programs): Remaining CS requirements — identify specific courses needed (15-440, 15-316, etc.)
Step 3 (policies): AW = max ~45 units → ~3-4 courses possible
Conclusion: If 15-440 is required, Spring 2026 graduation is NOT feasible; earliest graduation would be after Fall 2026 when 15-440 is next available
